review_candidates.description: Are you living in Denmark and looking for a student job where your analytical skills create a real-world impact? Do you want to play a key role in designing a highly cost-efficient, compliant financial ecosystem for an international NGO?   MMCC Global (www.MMCCglobal.org) is an international NGO working with children and youth in some of the world’s most challenging contexts, including Afghanistan, Bangladesh, and Ethiopia. We are a growing organisation managed by a lean, agile team of 2-3 core staff members in Denmark. Because we are a small organization, cost efficiency is at the absolute core of everything we do—our priority is to minimize administrative overhead so that every possible Krone or USD goes directly to our projects.   We operate across multiple borders, manage funding from diverse international donors, and run projects using various local currencies. To support our next phase of growth, we are looking for a sharp, structurally minded Student Assistant / Junior Controller who can help us analyze, optimize, and manage our global financial workflows with a strict focus on cost-minimization and compliance. It wouldn’t hurt if you are curious for exploring AI supported solutions.   Your First Mission: The Cost & Feasibility Analysis During the initial period of your employment, you will act as our internal project manager and help evaluating our future financial infrastructure. Working closely with management, you will:   Cost-Benefit System Evaluation: Analyze our multi-currency and project-tracking needs to help us select the most cost-effective software setup. You will evaluate the feasibility of utilizing QuickBooks (currently used by our local program in Afghanistan) versus integrating it with a certified, budget-friendly Danish cloud ERP (e.g., e-conomic or Uniconta), ensuring we meet the strict digital compliance standards of the Danish Bookkeeping Act without overspending on IT licenses.   Outsourcing & Transition Strategy: Conduct a thorough pros-and-cons analysis of moving our day-to-day project bookkeeping from Denmark to our trusted Program Finance Manager in Afghanistan. If the analysis proves it is more cost-efficient and operationally sound, you will plan and execute the step-by-step transition.   Streamline Danish Operations: Create a split-accounting system where global project bookkeeping is handled affordably abroad, while Danish payroll, sensitive salary components, and final oversight are finalized locally in Denmark.   Tender for an NGO-Savvy Auditor: Prepare a Request for Proposal (RFP) to source a new audit partner in Denmark who offers the right balance of international NGO expertise and competitive pricing.   Your Ongoing Role: Project Controlling & Danish Compliance Once the most cost-efficient structure is implemented, your role will transition into driving our ongoing financial operations:   Project Budget Tracking: Monitor project spending against specific donor budgets to prevent overruns and maximize resource utility.   Liquidity Forecasting and Cash Flow Projections: Provide quarterly overviews of our financial position   Danish Regulatory Compliance: Act as our internal anchor for safeguarding our §8A tax-deductibility status (tracking required members and supporters to secure critical funding), navigating SKAT regulations, and monitoring public collection permissions (Indsamlingsnævnet).   Currency & Quality Control: Perform quality assurance on data received from international operations, handle foreign exchange reconciliations, and track cash flows across international project accounts.   Who You Are The Academic Profile: You are currently pursuing a university degree (Bachelor’s or Master’s level) at institutions like Copenhagen Business School (CBS) or similar, specializing in Accounting & Finance, Management Accounting, Business Intelligence, or International Business.   The Resourceful Mindset: You possess excellent Excel skills and a solid theoretical understanding of project accounting. You instinctively look for lean solutions, hate administrative waste, and enjoy finding clever ways to optimize processes on a limited budget.   The Communicator (English Work Language + Danish Fluency): Our daily operations and project tracking are conducted entirely in English, so full professional fluency is mandatory. However, because you will be dealing directly with Danish authorities, auditors, laws, and §8A requirements, you must be able to read and understand Danish at a professional level.   The Purpose-Driven Professional: You are motivated by our mission and excited by the responsibility of a small organization where your work directly shapes our operational capacity.   What We Offer A high degree of autonomy and the chance to build an international financial workflow from scratch. Flexibility around your university exam periods. A fair student salary, starting at 150 dkk per hour. An international, meaningful, and dynamic working environment. Hours: Flexible equal approximately 12-15 hours per week. Location: Fully or partial remote work with Copenhagen as the hub for in-person meetings   How to Apply Send your CV and a brief cover letter explaining why you are the right fit for this transformation role to info@MMCCglobal.org no later than 23 rd October 2026. Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis. Start date asap – to be agreed upon.
